title: Canonical tensor-Hom representative model
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use its derived category and recorded tensor [def-pc-derived-category] [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For a family of functions $t_{K,L,M}:\operatorname{Hom}(K,R\mathcal Hom(L,M))\to\operatorname{Hom}(K\otimes^L L,M)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], define its normalization predicate as follows. Require naturality in all three variables. Fix the functorial K-injective resolution $I(M)$ [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], its inverse localized resolution map, and the fixed localization factorization $j_{L,M}:R\mathcal Hom(QL,QM)\cong Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. For every K-flat $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], complexes $L,M$, and chain map $\phi:P\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$, require a map $\psi:\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes L)\to I(M)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] whose restriction on $P^p\otimes L^q$ is the sheaf tensor-Hom uncurrying of the degree-$p$ projection of $\phi$, with symmetry restoring the tensor order [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Require $t_{QP,QL,QM}(Q\phi;j_{L,M}^{-1})=\mu_X(P,L);Q\psi;(Q\eta_M)^{-1}$ with the recorded model map [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. This is the equivalence-valued normalization predicate with no inverse or bijectivity requirement. The resolution, factorization and component definitions are the existing constructions, extracted unchanged to a shared module.
